For the Petitioners : Ms. Shreya, Advocate For the State : Mr. Deepankar, Advocate .................
04/Dated: 19/08/2023 Ms. Shreya, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are husband and in-laws of respondent no.2.
She submits that the case has been registered under section 498A of I.P.C. and other sections of I.P.C.
She submits that the respondent no. 2 has already filed case bearing Manicktala P.S. Case No. 70 of 2021 under sections 498A of I.P.C. and under section 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
She submits that for the same cause of action present case has been filed which is against the mandate of law.

She relied in the case of " T.T. Antony Vs. State of Kerala" reported in (2001) 6 SCC 181.
2.

entities.text: T.T. Antony Vs. State of Kerala" reported in (2001) 6 SCC 181
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Let notice be issued upon respondent no.2 under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week.
3. Till the next date no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners in connection with Complaint Case No. 632 of 2022, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Koderma.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/
